rule: patterns are exact (JSON escapes only); substring = exact occurrence; regex = Python re.search; regex_count = number of re.findall matches, compared with expected_count; flags S = DOTALL, I = IGNORECASE; a scope (scope_start and scope_end, both required) restricts the text to the block from the first occurrence of scope_start up to (not including) the next occurrence of scope_end; if either marker is absent from the text the scope is EMPTY (fail closed: a scoped check cannot match outside its scope); a check is ok when its result is TRUE, its positive_control satisfies the predicate, and neither its negative_control nor any entry of near_miss_controls does; every source carries its expected identity (expected_blob, or expected_section_sha256 for a section of a file at the branch HEAD), which is the identity set of BA-03 V5 section 2; a BOUND source is resolved at bound_product_sha and at origin/main (and at the build source SHA when the optional second argument is given) and every resolution must equal expected_blob; a resolved identity that differs from it, or cannot be resolved, is an identity drift; the run fails (exit 1) on any failed check or control, any identity drift, or a bound_product_sha (or build source SHA) that does not resolve; the output argument is mandatory
